title: Drunk Wisconsin Man Learns What 'F**k Around and Find Out' Means
description:
Bodycam and dashcam footage show a Wisconsin man fleeing from police on a stolen piece of construction equipment. Tyler Peschke stole a skid steer from the Appleton mall and took it for a joyride through city streets and cornfields. The drunken Peschke told officers it “looked like fun.” Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
